The JSON catalogs are authored synthetic data under the project license. Names, URLs, identifiers, metadata and episode counts are invented; no provider responses or user database extracts are included.

Regenerate them from the repository root with `node apps/server/scripts/generate-public-fixtures.mjs`. Run their grouping and franchise assertions with `corepack pnpm --filter @moa/server verify:live` (this compatibility command is entirely offline).
